rca of the issue: One transient failure observed: served /index.html initially contained the OLD meta description even though /app/frontend/public/index.html on disk was updated. RCA: CRA (react-scripts) dev server serves index.html from a cached representation and does not watch public/index.html for changes. Fix: sudo supervisorctl restart frontend after edits to public/index.html. Recommend main agent note this for future public/ asset changes.
